events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
...HOT AND DRY WITH GUSTY WINDS AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT SATURDAY
AFTERNOON AND EVENING...

Hot and dry conditions today will combined with increase
southerly winds ahead of an approaching cold front. Expect
sustained winds of 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph with
humidities between 15 and 25 percent. Eastern portions of 423
along with zone 426 has seen little to no rainfall in the last two
weeks keeping fuels critically dry.

* AFFECTED AREA...In Idaho, Fire Weather Zones 423 Owyhee
Mountains and 426 Southern Highlands.

* TIMING...Until 9 PM MDT this evening.

* WINDS...Southwest 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...15 to 25 percent.

* TEMPERATURES...78 to 86 degrees.

* IMPACTS...Any fire that develops will catch and spread
quickly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.

FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
East Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 415 PM MST.

* At 121 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the Vail area with another area developing across
the east side of Tucson. Between 0.75 and 1.5 inches of rain have
fallen in the Vail area. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tucson, Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Tanque Verde, Vail, Saguaro
National Park East and Rita Ranch.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 10 between mile markers 268 and 289. Route 83 between mile
markers 53 and 58.

This includes the following Flash Flood Prone Locations...
Harrison Rd at Pantano Wash, Agua Caliente Wash from Soldier Trl to
Fort Lowell, Wentworth Rd at Tanque Verde Wash, Tanque Verde Loop Rd
at Tanque Verde Wash, Old Spanish Trl at Rincon Creek, Houghton Rd
from I-10 & Sahuarita Rd, Escalante Rd at Atterbury Wash, Alamo Wash
between Speedway and Grant, Andrada Rd east of Wentworth Rd, Camino
Loma Alta at Rincon Creek, Freeman Rd between Broadway and Old
Spanish Trail, Old Spanish Trail at Jeremy Wash and Calle Rinconada
Rd from Andrada Rd to Sahuarita Rd.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Ventana Canyon Wash, Santa Cruz River, Rincon Creek, Cienega Creek,
Tanque Verde Wash, Rillito River, Chico, Arroyo, Sabino Creek,
Mescal Arroyo, Coyote Wash, Agua Verde Creek and Pantano Wash.
